metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot / PKU)
metabolic_screening.program: Rhode Island Department of Health — Newborn Screening Program
metabolic_screening.state_form_note: RI has a specific 'Refusal of Consent for Newborn Blood Screening' form. Religious exemption available — screening is mandated unless it conflicts with religious tenets and practices. The form is a standalone PDF from RI DOH.
metabolic_screening.kit_ordering_note: NBS supplies ordered through RI DOH; specimens shipped to RI State Health Laboratories.
metabolic_screening.specimen_tracking_note: NBS tracking via RI State Health Laboratories; midwives verify specimen receipt.
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Complete RI NBS TRF 12–48h after birth, give refusal form to parents if declining, send specimen+TRF to RI lab.
metabolic_screening.declination_law: RI General Laws — religious exemption; refusal of consent form required for declination.

billing.note: Parents are billed directly; most insurance covers screening; midwife is NOT billed for the screening test itself.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.program: Rhode Island EHDI Program — RI DOH
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Hearing screening refusal uses the same Refusal of Consent form. RI mandates hearing screening; refusal documented on the form.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents; if opted-in, refer to EHDI-approved audiologist; if declined, document refusal on consent form.
hearing_screening.law: RI General Statutes — hearing screening mandated with religious exemption

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening (critical congenital heart disease)
cchd_screening.program: Rhode Island CCHD Screening — RI DOH
cchd_screening.state_form_note: CCHD screening refusal uses the same Refusal of Consent form. Pulse ox performed at bedside; refusal documented on the form.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse-ox screening; document refusal on consent form if declined.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: Eye prophylaxis is a standard of care; no standalone state declination form — practice standard is a signed informed-refusal/waiver document (app master form).
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If opted-in: administer erythromycin within 2h of birth. If declined: signed informed refusal (in-app master form) retained in records.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in-app; shot administered by midwife or referred.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; administered dose reported to RI Immunization Registry.

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal)
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; swab testing via referral or in-office; intrapartum antibiotics referred if opted-in.
